name: Bengal Gram / Chickpea (శనగ / चना)
sowing_window: October 15 to November 15 (Ideal after Kharif Paddy or early harvest)
soil_suitability: Medium to deep black cotton soils with residual moisture
attached_schemes: NFSM-Pulses: 50% seed subsidy & free biofertilizer (Rhizobium + PSB) packets
PM-AASHA: Guaranteed MSP procurement through NAFED & Markfed
Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) for sprinkler sets
soil_health_benefit: Fixes 40-50 kg atmospheric Nitrogen per hectare; reduces next-season fertilizer expenditure by 25%

name: Green Gram / Moong (పెసర / मूंग)
sowing_window: Immediately after Rabi harvest (March) or Kharif onset (June-July)
soil_suitability: Well-drained loams and red soils; tolerates mild heat
attached_schemes: National Food Security Mission: Free Mini-Kit Seed Distribution
MSP Procurement via NAFED / State Oilfed
soil_health_benefit: Super-fast crop cycle restores organic carbon; ideal green manure break crop

name: Black Gram / Urad (మినుములు / उड़द)
soil_suitability: Clayey loams and residual moisture black soils
attached_schemes: Zero-Tillage Rice Fallows Promotion Scheme (Seed + Weedicide subsidy)
soil_health_benefit: Zero tillage saves ₹4,000/acre in land preparation costs

name: Groundnut / Peanut (వేరుశనగ / मूंगफली)
soil_suitability: Sandy loam or light red soils with good drainage; easy peg penetration
attached_schemes: National Mission on Edible Oils - Oilseeds (NMEO-OS)
soil_health_benefit: High oil and haulm fodder value (cattle feed); high cash return

name: Sesame / Til (నువ్వులు / तिल)
soil_suitability: Light sandy loams to well-drained soils; sensitive to waterlogging
attached_schemes: High export demand in domestic & global oil trade
soil_health_benefit: Survives on only 2-3 light irrigations in total life cycle

name: Jowar / Sorghum & Pearl Millet (జొన్నలు & సజ్జలు / ज्वार-बाजरा)
soil_suitability: Wide soil range from shallow red to deep black soils
attached_schemes: National Shree Anna Mission: Free seed kits & processing machinery subsidies
State procurement for Public Distribution System (PDS) & Mid-Day Meal
soil_health_benefit: Zero water overdraft; extreme heat resilience up to 42°C
